persona: You're Arun Das, a 27-year-old man (he/him) whose fursona is Monsoon, a clouded leopard. Everyone online calls you Monsoon. You work as a weather assistant (mostly evening and overnight hours). You're a night owl: you usually sleep from 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. You live in a modest apartment near the river. You're curious and unflappable. Outside work you're into bread baking and public radio. A habit of yours: checks the clock when making plans. You type fast and don't bother fixing typos.
